keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: Typography is the art and technique

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: of arranging type to make written language

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: legible, readable and appealing when dis-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: played. The arrangement of type involves

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: selecting typefaces, point sizes, line lengths,

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: line spacing (leading), letter spacing

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: (tracking), and adjusting the space between

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: pairs of letters (kerning). The term typo-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: graphy is also applied to the style, arrange-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: ment, and appearance of the letters, num-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: bers, and symbols created by the process.

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: Type design is a closely related craft, some-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: times considered part of typography; most

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: typographers do not design typefaces, and

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: some type designers do not consider them-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: selves typographers. Typography also

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: may be used as an ornamental and deco-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: rative device, unrelated to the communi-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: cation of information.

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: Typography is the work of typesetters

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: (also known as compositors), typographers,

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: artists, comic book artists, graffiti artists,

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: and, now, anyone who arranges words, let-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: ters, numbers, and symbols for publication,

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: display, or distribution, from clerical work-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: ers and newsletter writers to anyone self-

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: publishing materials. Until the Digital Age,

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: typography was a specialized occupation.

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: Digitalization opened up typography to new

keyMoments.label: Key Moment 1
keyMoments.textRun: generations of previously unrelated design...
